description: Paid (x402, 0.001 USD). Returns the gas module's recommendation for a chain: the module name, its stated reason, and whether it abstained. Input: chain (chain identifier; the underlying route defaults to 'eth' when omitted). Without a valid payment proof the call returns the route's 402 payment requirements.

chain.description: Chain identifier to evaluate, e.g. 'eth'. Optional — the underlying route defaults to 'eth' when omitted.

payment_signature.description: Caller-supplied x402 v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE. Omit to receive the payment requirements.

name: mnemos_gas_recommend
title: MNEMOS Gas Recommendation
